runners.comment: Well treated on last year's Tapeta form but recent efforts no more than respectable
runners.name: Mr Baloo
runners.spotlight: Now 6lb lower than for the latest of his four wins on Tapeta (7f-9.5f) early last year, but recent efforts don't strongly suggest he can capitalise on this sliding mark, finishing behind the reopposing Miletus when fourth at Lingfield in refitted blinkers latest.

runners.breeder: S C E A Le Haras DHaspel
runners.comment: Went close at Wolverhampton in December; possible excuses since; given another chance
runners.name: Shihoku
runners.spotlight: Ran well for close second over 8.6f at Wolverhampton in December; beaten favourite twice since but there have been possible excuses, as he likely did too much too soon over 9.4f back there on the first occasion and his rider lost an iron at the start (not regained for a number of strides) over C&D since; withdrawn from an intended start last month after refusing to go in the stalls; the Wolverhampton second is solid form and he might be worth another chance.

runners.comment: Backed up 1m Lingfield win last month with a fast-finishing fourth there 18 days ago
runners.name: Elouises Prince
runners.spotlight: Sprung a 25-1 surprise at Lingfield last month and caught the eye with a power-packed finish from too far back when fourth there (also 1m) 18 days ago; that suggests his mark is still workable.

runners.comment: Changed hands after good third at Newcastle in January but well held over C&D since
runners.name: Midnights Dream
runners.spotlight: Two wins for Roger Varian last year, over 7f here and 1m at Leicester; ended his time with that yard with a solid third at Newcastle in January but well beaten over C&D for new yard 14 days ago.

18:30.race_name: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier) (Div I)

runners.comment: Best run for new connections when second at Chelmsford last month; C&D winner; chance
runners.name: Gallant
runners.spotlight: Ran his best race for new connections when a front-running second of six at Chelmsford three weeks ago (6f); runs off the same mark here and has a C&D win on his record; one to consider.

runners.comment: Ended 2025 with 6f hat-trick, including here; running okay this year; each-way shout
runners.name: Justcallmepete
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a 6f hat-trick, the first of the wins coming over C&D; respectable efforts this year but he has a bit of work to do with Gallant on latest Chelmsford run.

runners.breeder: D & S L Tanker Transport Ltd
runners.comment: Useful form when 2nd over C&D on penultimate start; has it in him to run a big race
runners.name: Intervention
runners.spotlight: Not as consistent as he once was but still capable of useful form on both turf and AW, running a fine race for second over C&D on his penultimate start; only midfield at Southwell 12 days ago but no surprise to see him bounce back with a bigger run.

runners.comment: Conditions fine and on a feasible mark; new blinkers could give him a lift; considered
runners.name: Stanley Spencer
runners.spotlight: Two of his four wins have come over C&D and he is just 1lb higher than for his latest success, a 6f win at Southwell last September; recent efforts need bettering but the addition of blinkers is a possible source of improvement.

runners.comment: Feasible mark on last season's best but perhaps best watched on today's stable debut
runners.name: Daring Legend
runners.spotlight: Feasibly weighted on last season's best efforts for Mick Appleby; sold for 35,000gns last October; has run well after a break in the past but perhaps best watched on this stable debut.

runners.comment: Won this race in 2025 off 1lb higher and arrives this time chasing a four-timer; big shout
runners.name: Supreme King
runners.spotlight: He had tumbled down the weights prior to a 6f win at Southwell in December and he followed that with wins at Newcastle and over C&D; up 9lb since his winning spree started but he is still 1lb lower than when winning the corresponding race 12 months ago; strong claims.

runners.comment: Came up short in Class 4 latest but Donagh Murphy's claim a bonus and stable in good form
runners.name: Lazzar
runners.spotlight: Rattled off a 6f hat-trick around the turn of the year; came up short in Class 4 company last time but has the assistance of Donagh Murphy's bonus 7lb today; yard in form; considered.

runners.breeder: S A S U Ecurie Des Monceaux Et Al
runners.comment: Solid chance on 2025 best but ended the year quietly and down the field on his return
runners.name: Rebel Path
runners.spotlight: On a dangerous mark on 2025 best but he ended that campaign with some lesser efforts and it was the same story on his return to action five weeks ago; others look safer.

runners.comment: On a good mark and penultimate C&D fourth was promising; strong early pace would help
runners.name: Expert Agent
runners.owner: J P Morris Mrs V A Tunnicliffe Et Al
runners.spotlight: Two turf wins last summer and now features on a lower mark than for either of them; fully effective over C&D and his penultimate run, where he came from a long way back to take fourth, suggested he was primed to strike; strong early pace would bring him into the reckoning.

19:00.race_name: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier) (Div II)

runners.breeder: Mme Isabelle Mauger & Mr Guy Benachour
runners.comment: Got on top towards the finish over 6f at Chelmsford latest and only 2lb higher now
runners.name: Dyrholaey
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer who landed his first handicap success when getting on top towards the finish at Chelmsford (6f) last month; only 2lb higher so should remain competitive.

runners.comment: Seven turf wins, including two in the autumn, but he's 0-8 on AW
runners.name: Marching Mac
runners.spotlight: Had a good spell in the mud on turf last autumn but ended his year with a lesser run at Newcastle in November, taking his AW record to 0-8; might be best watched after 97 days off.

runners.comment: Has a win and good second to show from his two C&D runs this winter; big player
runners.name: Buccabay
runners.spotlight: Made his AW breakthrough when scoring over C&D in December; matched that form when second over C&D in January and big player with Billy Loughnane taking over in the saddle for the first time.

runners.comment: Useful 2yo but struggled since, including two recent AW outings
runners.name: Mr Lightside
runners.spotlight: Useful as 2yo, winning twice before finishing third in the Group 3 Molecomb; went the wrong way in 2025 and has made a low-key return to action in recent weeks; the visor worn last time is discarded and replaced by blinkers; can only watch until showing more.

runners.comment: Back from break to win at Southwell in January and good second at Newcastle since; player
runners.name: Hundred Caps
runners.spotlight: Returned from a 103-day break to run out a ready winner of Southwell handicap in January; matched that form when second of 12 at Newcastle (also 6f) last time and ought to give another good account.

runners.comment: On a hat-trick but it was small-field race last time and this is stronger; also drawn wide
runners.name: City Cyclone
runners.spotlight: Has started 2026 with wins over C&D and in a small field at Wolverhampton (7f); only 1lb higher on the hat-trick bid but this is more competitive and he's drawn widest.

runners.comment: Front-runner; 5f Chelmsford win in January and creditable third of 12 over C&D since
runners.name: Merrimack
runners.spotlight: Recorded his first AW success (four turf wins) when making all in 5f handicap at Chelmsford in January; most of his wins have come at that trip but his C&D third a fortnight ago underlines he is effective at 6f.

runners.comment: C&D winner in 2024; has shown he retains ability this winter since back from an absence
runners.name: Nemov
runners.spotlight: C&D winner for Clive Cox in August 2024; has shown he retains ability in three AW outings for new yard since returning from an absence, on the latest leading for a long way (raced keenly) in the C&D handicap won by City Cyclone in January; was backed into favouritism on that occasion and it will be interesting to see whether his supporters are prepared to give him another chance six weeks on.

19:30.race_name: Unibet Proudly Supports racinghome.org.uk Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Did well in turf sprint maidens at 2, winning at Catterick; more to come in handicaps
runners.name: The Lost Sock
runners.spotlight: Did well in sprint maidens on turf last summer, going close in quite a useful race at Thirsk before landing the odds at Catterick (also 5f); subsequently gelded; appeals as one who can go on to even better things in handicaps this time round.

runners.breeder: New England Stud A Nicoll & P Vela
runners.comment: Progressive first four runs and possible excuse last time; could bounce back
runners.name: Augustus Gloop
runners.spotlight: Improved with each of his three runs in novice/maiden company, getting off the mark in a four-runner event at Newcastle in September; another step forward when second to Saffron Dandy (followed up in warm race at Lingfield last week) on 6f Wolverhampton handicap debut in January and possibly found a second run after a break coming too soon when only sixth at Newcastle ten days later; freshened up since; could bounce back with a bang.

runners.comment: AW maiden win on final 2yo start; fourth in nursery at York's Ebor meeting before that
runners.name: River Spey
runners.spotlight: Fourth in big-field York Ebor meeting nursery off 1lb lower last summer and ended his first campaign with 6f Chelmsford maiden win (AW debut); claims if ready to roll after 146 days off.

runners.comment: AW winner; also pushed a prolific sort close in November but below par final run
runners.name: Eternal Solace
runners.spotlight: 5.5f turf and 6f Polytrack winner; back on the up when close second at Southwell (6f) in November but last of five over that C&D in December; been off for 11 weeks.

runners.comment: AW maiden win; not up to Listed level final 2yo start but retains potential down in grade
runners.name: Inside Story
runners.spotlight: Second in C&D novice last July and went one better in 6f Southwell maiden two months later; not up to Listed company on turf on her final start but retains potential with sights lowered on this return.

runners.comment: Second in a 6f nursery off 1lb higher last year but quite exposed after seven starts
runners.name: Saucy Jane
runners.owner: Nick Bradley Racing 16 And Jmr Partners
runners.spotlight: Beverley maiden winner over 5f; also second in 6f Haydock nursery off 1lb higher last summer but quite exposed after seven starts and may be vulnerable to progressive types on this AW debut and reappearance.

runners.comment: Promising; made all with ease in maiden last month and more to come in handicaps; player
runners.name: Sparksmith
runners.spotlight: Promising start to his career and he was off the mark on third start when easily making all in 6f Wolverhampton maiden last month; likely there's more to come from him now handicapping and he's a must for the shortlist.

runners.comment: Came good in AW maiden last time but it was ninth start and more needed back in handicap
runners.name: Alasrae
runners.spotlight: Didn't need to improve when making it ninth time lucky in 6f Wolverhampton maiden in January; twice held in AW handicaps off this mark in December and will need to raise his game if he's to make it back-to-back wins.

20:00.race_name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Handicap (London Middle Distance Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: In frame five times on AW this winter but he's only 1-17 overall
runners.name: Jodhpur Blue
runners.spotlight: Only 1-17 but arrives here in a fair run of form, reaching the frame for the fifth time this winter when second at Chelmsford (1m2f) last time.

runners.breeder: Lofts Hall Stud B Sangster New England
runners.comment: Two more AW wins this winter but held on last three starts
runners.name: Tortured Soul
runners.spotlight: Gained narrow wins at Lingfield (1m2f, Polytrack) and Southwell (1m3f, Tapeta) this winter but the handicapper has looked in charge in recent starts.

runners.breeder: S C H H The Aga Khans Studs
runners.comment: Promise in handicaps around 1m in Ireland last year; market interesting on yard debut
runners.name: Rizal
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in four handicap starts around 1m on turf in Ireland for Johnny Murtagh last year; new connections went to 58,000euros to acquire him in November and are quick to step him up in trip (also AW debut); market confidence could prove significant.

runners.breeder: J Cypres N Cypres & Earl Ecurie D
runners.comment: Second over 1m3f at Southwell in January but only sixth over C&D since
runners.name: Lilly Lux
runners.spotlight: Ex-French mare who ran her best race for new stable when beaten a neck into second at Southwell (1m3f) in January; failed to reproduce that when only sixth over C&D since.

runners.comment: Has qualified for handicaps over 1m; dam won over 1m3f so longer trip could suit
runners.name: Kurios Lady
runners.spotlight: All three starts over 1m at Southwell, showing fair form when reaching the frame on the last two; out of a 1m3f winner so the step up in trip could be a good move now handicapping.

runners.comment: No impact in three 1m Flat runs but interesting on bumper form now handicapping up in trip
runners.name: Naval Tribute
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in three bumpers in early 2025; no impact in three 1m maidens switched to the Flat in recent months but could prove a different proposition now handicapping over a longer trip for his good stable; first-time cheekpieces also go on; interesting, particularly if backed.

runners.comment: Fast-finishing fourth over 1m2f at Lingfield in January but below that level twice since
runners.name: Meet Me In Meraki
runners.owner: Spiers & Hartwell Ltd & Mrs E Evans
runners.spotlight: Fast-finishing fourth over 1m2f at Lingfield in January but he hasn't found the same form in two subsequent outings there; Marquand up but others bring more compelling claims.

runners.breeder: S A R L De Chambure Haras DEtreham
runners.comment: C&D win for new yard in January and better than result over 1m4f since; gets the vote
runners.name: Sonnerie Power
runners.spotlight: Dropped a long way in the weights during a winless spell with Mick Appleby and returned from a ten-month absence to make a winning start for new connections over C&D in January; had a bit up his sleeve that day and a subsequent defeat over 1m4f probably shouldn't be taken as evidence the handicapper has him as he was still in front entering the final furlong; player back at 1m3f.

runners.comment: Off since third on 1m2f AW handicap debut last April; might be best watched this time
runners.name: Pershalla
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who has been absent since finishing 6.5l third of seven on 1m2f Lingfield handicap debut last April; returns in competitive race and a watching brief is the percentage call.

runners.comment: Runaway Wolverhampton win in November but struggled off higher marks since
runners.name: Three Yorkshiremen
runners.spotlight: Back to form with a runaway win over 1m4f at Wolverhampton in November but he shot up the weights after that and his form has nosedived since.

runners.comment: Third on all four AW starts this winter, including C&D; each-way claims again
runners.name: Voix De Bocelli
runners.spotlight: He has finished third in all four starts since returning to the AW, including to Sonnerie Power over C&D; each-way claims again.

runners.comment: 1m4f Tapeta win last month; just as good when second at Lingfield since; considered
runners.name: Take The Boat
runners.spotlight: Successful on her fourth start for this yard in an amateurs' event at Wolverhampton (Tapeta) last month; creditable second of 11 off this mark at Lingfield (also 1m4f) since; should go well again.

runners.comment: 7f Lingfield win in January and fair third there since; drawn wide but still respected
runners.name: Ashford Hill
runners.spotlight: Reappeared to win Lingfield handicap in January and respectable third of eight back there (also 7f) since; the widest stall could be tricky but she brings much more compelling form claims than most.

runners.comment: No impact so far and first-time blinkers need to spark improvement
runners.name: Emperors Logic
runners.spotlight: Poor form so far, beating only one home switched to handicap company on last three starts; first-time blinkers join last time's newly fitted tongue-tie.

runners.comment: Pretty useful as a 2yo but her form has nosedived since
runners.name: Griselda
runners.spotlight: Won three times in succession (6f) as a juvenile for George Scott, rising to a mark in the low-to-mid 80s; fortunes have since nosedived, finishing down the field on all seven starts for this trainer; has first-time tongue-tie added to the cheekpieces she's worn on her last three outings.

runners.comment: Patchy record but beaten only 2l when fifth in similar race at Lingfield last time
runners.name: Huntly Lodge
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo with a patchy record, although he was beaten only 2l when fifth in a similar race at Lingfield under Jack Dace last time; each-way shout with a repeat of that form.

runners.comment: Regressive since AW maiden win in November 2024
runners.name: Just King High
runners.spotlight: AW maiden winner in November 2024 but out of the frame in 12 handicap starts since; dips into classified company for the first time but still tough to fancy.

runners.comment: 0-14 but fair fourth in Lingfield handicap last week; stall 1 handy for prominent racer
runners.name: Miraflores
runners.spotlight: 0-14 but has been competitive in a few of her handicap starts this winter, including fourth of seven at Lingfield (7f) last week; often front runs so the inside stall is handy.

runners.comment: 0-8 and no improvement for the drop to classified company on his last two starts
runners.name: Nutcracker
runners.spotlight: 0-8 and no improvement for the drop to classified company on his last two starts.

runners.comment: Seven-race maiden who has little in the way of solid form; new headgear tried
runners.name: Petra Grey
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who has little in the way of solid form; first-time blinkers replace cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Not found best form this winter but latest third in a similar race at Lingfield was better
runners.name: Rainbow Sign
runners.spotlight: Strike-rate of 3-61 so thoroughly exposed but latest third in 1m Lingfield classified event is reasonable form for the level; each-way shout assuming a wide stall isn't too troublesome.

runners.comment: Faded having briefly slipped clear on home turn over 9.4f latest; return to 7f may help
runners.name: Resilient Lady
runners.spotlight: Has been tried over a variety of trips in her 11-race career but this drop back to 7f could suit given the way she shaped in a similar race over 9.4f at Wolverhampton last time, pulling hard in first-time blinkers (retained) and having nothing left having raced in a clear lead from 3f out until over 1f out; enters calculations.

runners.comment: 15-race maiden with low-level form; makes little appeal
runners.name: Tilsworth Silver
runners.spotlight: 15-race maiden with low-level form; makes little appeal.

runners.breeder: P I Foreman & S A Sharrock
runners.comment: Classy sort for classified level on best form but largely struggled in 2025; off 139 days
runners.name: Twitch
runners.owner: The Limes Of Epsom Racing Club
runners.spotlight: Two 7f Chelmsford wins in autumn 2024 but largely struggled in 2025; hopes are pinned on a 139-day break sparking a revival.

runners.comment: 6f course win in December and mostly respectable efforts since; solid contender
runners.name: Vitalline
runners.spotlight: His hold-up style makes him a bit of a hostage to fortune but he won a 6f course handicap in December and has mostly run respectably since; one of the more likely types in this field.
